cards.title: Balancing Work and Childcare This Summer
cards.body: The summer holidays bring annual challenges for parents juggling work and childcare. With rising holiday childcare costs, The Guardian is collecting stories from parents about how they're managing this summer.

cards.title: The Difference Between Needs and Wants
cards.body: Wants are strategies to meet underlying needs—once you understand this distinction, parenting frustrations become clearer. Children's behavior often points to an unmet need rather than misbehavior.

cards.title: Does Your College Student Have ADHD?
cards.body: ADHD diagnoses are rising among young adults entering college life. Here are 13 practical ways to support your child as they prepare for the transition to higher education.

cards.title: Minority Mental Health Month for Young Children
cards.body: Mental health equity begins in infancy through nurturing relationships and early support. National Minority Mental Health Awareness Month reminds parents of the importance of connection and accessible mental health care for children.

cards.title: Childhood Trauma and Emotional Neglect Healing
cards.body: Emotional neglect is one of the most misunderstood childhood experiences. Childhood trauma casts a long shadow, but it can be healed with proper support and help.

cards.title: Five Ways to Make Most of Summer
cards.body: The summer holidays offer great opportunities for affordable family fun and bonding. Here are expert tips and tricks to make the most of your break with kids.
